usage: Secrets should be stored explicitly as encrypted GitHub Actions Secrets
name: Secrets should be stored explicitly as encrypted GitHub Actions Secrets
description: GitHub Actions used secrets should be stored explicitly as secrets and not variables. If stored as secrets, the secrets will appear encrypted. Variables appear in plain text.
detailedDescription: To lower the risk of leaking secrets on the compromise of a GitHub Runner, there exists an option to store secrets in the Secrets section of GitHub Actions. When stored in the Secrets section, secrets are encrypted. If the secret is kept in the variable area, then the secret is in plaintext and has the potential to be leaked.
notes: This policy currently only applies to GitHub.
